overview.emptyText: Add your first card – it is imported from the card database automatically.

fields.name: Name
fields.ownerHint: Handing the card over to another user: afterwards only that user can change it.

delete.title: Delete card?
delete.text: “{name}” is deleted permanently, including price and status history and all images.

card.basicsHint: Names, texts and attributes come from the card database. Set code and edition can be adjusted (e.g. for German or Japanese prints) and apply to every language.

refresh.hint: Fetch texts, attributes and prices again. Set code, edition, status and owner stay unchanged.

card.lastFetched: Data last fetched from the API on {date}
card.basicsHintVariant: Names, texts and data come from the card database. Only the variant of your card (e.g. Reverse Holo or 1st Edition) can be adjusted.

readOnly.owned: This card belongs to {owner}. You can look at it, but only {owner} can change it.
readOnly.noOwner: This card has no owner and cannot be changed. The owner has to be set in the database.

add.title: Add card
add.languageHint: The search looks for German first, then English. German, English and (for Pokémon) Japanese texts are stored where available.
add.manyResults: Only the first results are shown. Narrow the search, e.g. with the card id (swsh3-136).
add.idHint: Pokémon: name or card id (set id and number, e.g. swsh3-136).
add.variantRequired: Choose the variant of your card.

bySet.invalidNumber: Enter the number as printed on the card, e.g. 040/088 or 40.
bySet.setHint: Pick the set by its name or logo. Typing the number as 040/088 narrows the sets down by their printed size.
bySet.filteredBySize: Only sets with {total} printed cards. Several sets can share the same size, so check the set name.
bySet.sizeMismatch: The card number says {typed} cards, but this set has {official}. Check that this is the right set.
bySet.numberMissing: This set has no card with the number {number}.
bySet.found: Card found by set and number

add.ownerNote: The card is added to your collection ({name}). Only you can change it afterwards.

edition.label: Edition
edition.hint: Choose the edition printed on your card, or leave it open.
edition.needsPrinting: Choose a printing first, the edition belongs to it.
edition.other: Another edition can be typed on the card page.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.upstream_card_not_found: The card was not found in the card database.
errors.upstream_rate_limited: The card database is busy. Please try again later.
errors.upstream_unreachable: The card database is not reachable.
errors.upstream_error: The card database reported an error.
errors.upstream_invalid_response: The card database returned unexpected data.
errors.unsupported_image: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images are supported.
errors.no_external_id: This card is not linked to the card database.
errors.printing_required: Please choose the variant of the card.
errors.invalid_variant: This variant does not exist for the card.
errors.field_not_editable: This field cannot be changed for this card.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.password_change_required: Please choose a new password first.
errors.not_card_owner: Only the owner can change this card.
errors.card_has_no_owner: This card has no owner and cannot be changed.
errors.password_too_short: The new password is too short (at least {min} characters).
errors.password_too_long: The new password is too long.
errors.password_initial: The new password must not be the initial password.
errors.password_unchanged: The new password must differ from the current one.

pokemon.noDetails: There are no further card details for this language.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Everybody can see all cards, but only change their own.

login.title: Log in
login.name: User name
login.hint: First login? The initial password is "cardkeeper"; you choose your own right afterwards.

account.title: Change password
account.hint: At least {min} characters. Other browsers are logged out when you change it.
account.forcedHint: You are using the initial password. Choose your own (at least {min} characters, not "cardkeeper") to continue.
account.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.
